items.title:
io.github.doantrantuandat:crnk-setup-spring-jackson3 4.0.0-lts.2 发布, Framework-agnostic Spring glue (RestTemplate client adapter, Spring Security/exception modules) for the
    Jackson 3 / tools.jackson.* line. SpringSecurityModule/SpringExceptionModule implement crnk-core's Module
    interface, whose ModuleContext type differs between the crnk-core and crnk-core-jackson3 lines, so - like
    crnk-setup-servlet-jackson3 - this needs its own build even though it has no Jackson coupling of its own.
    Imports the Spring Boot 4 BOM (not 3, unlike its sibling) since this module's own source compiles directly
    against Spring Framework/Security/Data APIs that moved between the two generations, and its only real
    consumer is crnk-setup-spring-boot4.

    list automatically from all subprojects via a pom.withXml hook), Maven has no equivalent - this list is
    hand-maintained and must be updated whenever a module is added to or removed from the root pom.xml's
    <modules> list. Deliberately excludes crnk-integration-examples/* (demo apps, never published -
    see each one's own central.skipPublishing=true property).

items.title:
de.speedbanking:iban-commons-de-checkdigit 1.8.11 发布, Zero-dependency implementation of the German banking industry's account number
        check digit methods ("Prüfzifferberechnungsmethoden in der deutschen Kreditwirtschaft"),
        as catalogued by the Deutsche Bundesbank. Validates whether a Kontonummer is
        structurally consistent for a given method, independently of any IBAN or BLZ
        master-data lookup. Deliberately standalone: does not depend on iban-commons,
        so it can be used on its own by callers that only have a BLZ and Kontonummer
        (e.g. legacy domestic payment processing) and have obtained the applicable
        method number from elsewhere (such as a BLZ master-data module).
